Normalize a country name for matching

Source: R/country_year_coder.R
normalize_country.Rd

Applies the transformations country_year_coder() uses on user-supplied country strings before the fuzzy regex join: transliterate to ASCII (to drop diacritics), lowercase, replace runs of punctuation with a single space, collapse whitespace, and trim.

Usage

normalize_country(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector.

Value

A normalized character vector, same length as x.

Details

Exported so callers who pre-merge their data against an external lookup can apply the same normalization to both sides and avoid surprises stemming from diacritics or punctuation.

Examples

democracyData::normalize_country(c("T\u00fcrkiye", "C\u00f4te d'Ivoire", "U.S.A.", "UK"))
#> [1] "turkiye"       "cote d ivoire" "u s a"         "uk"
